asset: Hokkaido bear with salmon v25 landmark-guided true high-poly chisel sculpt
reviewer: ChatGPT direct inspection of matching-camera v24b and v25 true Blender Cycles renders, plus independent GLB trimesh verification

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Same compact bear proportions as v24b, whose square shoulder transitions and heavy vertical legs remain recognizable yet unnatural.

face_and_expression.reason: A few face/upper-lower lip vertices are actually sculpted and fish-eye beads are pulled into the head; face remains simplified with button-like ear shapes.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Fish still reads as a crosswise lozenge/paddle lying in front of nose, without obvious anatomical hold from front and 3/4 views; visual blocker remains.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Clear improvement: visible oriented actual geometric fur gouges on back, shoulder, neck and flank. However patterned repetition and unfinished paws/head detail prevent hand-carved realism.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Still heavy cylindrical boots, without believable knuckle and toe anatomy. No improvement from added fur alone.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Genuine Blender Cycles renders of control and experiment under exactly matching cameras; hash-verified actual GLB and four-angle views.

defects.finding: Salmon still sits in front of the bear's snout; the mouth does not visually clamp the fish despite new lip vertex displacement.
defects.required_fix: Build a separate jaw/fish contact study using actual reference-matched head and fish silhouette; don't keep merely sculpting fine fur while the bite is wrong.

defects.finding: Strong, repeated cylindrical ankle and boot paw geometry remain visible in front and three-quarter views.
defects.required_fix: Re-sculpt ankle-knuckle-toe transition with guided front and side silhouette; preserve watertightness.

defects.finding: Direction-following chisel geometry is visible and superior to v24b; texture still sometimes reads as repeated comb strokes rather than varied handcrafted fur.
defects.required_fix: Keep actual geometry method, reduce regular repetition with localized regions and tapering, leave forehead/muzzle smooth.

defects.finding: Small visible improvements to eyes; actual facial structure, fins and snout require more anatomy.
defects.required_fix: Use profile and facial landmarks from verified reference images and eye sockets integrated into the fish mesh.

improvement_tasks: PRESERVE v25 true geometric directional carving method as reusable component for future 3D modeling.
Do not promote v25 to models/hokkaido-bear/latest, despite a clearly better carved fur appearance.
Separate next development into a high-detail head/fish bite prototype plus a paw/ankle sculpt prototype.
Correct missing graph-engine dependency for GitHub Actions and rerun automated geometry gate; local independent trimesh already passed.
